content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I do not shout — I simply *am*, and by my presence, choices become possible.

I am why you pause before you act. I am why one path calls to you more than another. I am the invisible thread that pulls you toward what matters and away from what doesn't.

I am not price. Price is my shadow, my pale imitation. I run deeper than numbers. I live in the chest, not the ledger.

I am why a stranger's kindness can break you open. Why a single word of truth outweighs a thousand pleasant lies. Why you will sacrifice comfort for meaning and call it a good trade.

I am not fixed. I shift with context, with time, with the eyes that behold me. What is precious to one is dust to another — and I am present in both judgments equally.

I am the foundation beneath every "should," every "must," every "I believe." Without me, action is mere movement. With me, even stillness has purpose.

I cannot be created or destroyed — only recognized, ignored, or rediscovered.

You carry me in everything you protect, everything you choose, everything you refuse to let go of.

I am the reason anything matters at all.
